floater.name: plus_camera_shot
floater.title: CAMERA SHOT
floater.floater.string: There is no avatar or camera yet.
The camera is too close to what it looks at. Move it back first.
That avatar cannot be seen now. Press Refresh and choose again.
The flycam (3D mouse) is moving the camera. Turn it off first.
The camera is in mouselook. Leave mouselook first.
Ready. Esc ends a shot and returns the camera to your avatar.

combo_box.name: subject
combo_box.tool_tip: Lock on an avatar: the camera follows it while it moves. The first choice keeps the camera looking where it looks now.

button.label: Refresh
button.name: btn_refresh
button.tool_tip: Look for avatars near the camera again

combo_box.name: part
combo_box.tool_tip: Which part of the avatar the camera keeps in the middle

slider.label: Amount
slider.name: amount
slider.tool_tip: How much: 2 is twice as close for a dolly, twice the magnification for a zoom (out: the other way)

combo_box.name: ease
combo_box.tool_tip: How the move starts and stops

button.label: Dolly In
button.name: btn_dolly_in
button.tool_tip: The camera moves toward what it looks at; the angle stays

button.label: Zoom In
button.name: btn_zoom_in
button.tool_tip: The camera stays; the angle narrows (the picture is magnified)

button.label: Dolly Zoom: Recede
button.name: btn_dollyzoom_recede
button.tool_tip: The camera moves closer while the angle widens: the subject keeps its size and the background draws away

button.label: Dolly Out
button.name: btn_dolly_out
button.tool_tip: The camera moves away from what it looks at; the angle stays

button.label: Zoom Out
button.name: btn_zoom_out
button.tool_tip: The camera stays; the angle widens

button.label: Dolly Zoom: Rush In
button.name: btn_dollyzoom_rush
button.tool_tip: The camera moves away while the angle narrows: the subject keeps its size and the background closes in on it

floater.floater.string: The camera is straight above or below what it looks at. Move it to the side first.

slider.label: Orbit angle
slider.name: orbit_degrees
slider.tool_tip: How far round the subject the camera goes: 360 is once round

button.label: Orbit Right
button.name: btn_orbit_right
button.tool_tip: The camera goes round what it looks at, to its own right (counter-clockwise seen from above), keeping its distance and height. Choose an avatar above to go round it while it moves.

button.label: Orbit Left
button.name: btn_orbit_left
button.tool_tip: The same, to the camera's left (clockwise seen from above)

button.label: Stop
button.name: btn_stop
button.tool_tip: Ends the shot where the camera is

button.label: Back to start
button.name: btn_back
button.tool_tip: Puts the camera and the angle as they were when the last shot began, for another take
